category_title: Students who disengage when restricted to traditional novels and lack of choice
scenario_title: Silent reading with restricted traditional novels
minimal_context: Lachlan is participating in a silent reading session using traditional novels from the class library.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for silent reading. Please choose a novel from the class library and read quietly at your desk.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No. only books in the class library. They ’re boring.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to pick one of these books to read right now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I like comic books, sports magazines. I don ’t like novels.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We don't have those right now. Just open the novel and look at the words.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stares at the page without moving his eyes) Then I would kind of fake read it. Like, look at the words but don ’t actually read it.

task.content: Silent reading session using books from the class library

context.materials: Traditional novels and books from the class library that did not have illustrations. (Note: comic books, sports magazines, 'horrible histories', and atlases were not previously available in the classroom collection)

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When forced to read books that he disliked, specifically books that did not have illustrations
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Avoids reading, engages in 'fake reading' by looking at the words but not actually reading them
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Finds the books boring and dislikes reading books without illustrations
